headline: Withdrew proposed zoning change to minimum lot area in RC-40 district; approved street closures for Middle Street Walk on December 12, 2026.
summary: A proposed zoning change to raise the minimum lot area per dwelling unit in the RC-40 (Coastal Residential) district from 20,000 sf to 40,000 sf was withdrawn at Councilor Memhard's request. Street closures of Middle Street for the Middle Street Walk on December 12, 2026, from 12:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. were also approved, with conditions.
decisions: Withdrew without prejudice the proposed amendment to the minimum lot area per dwelling unit for the RC-40 zoning district, 3-0.
Approved closing Middle Street from School Street to Washington Street on December 12, 2026, from 12:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. for the Middle Street Walk, with conditions, 3-0.

plain_text:
Planning & Development                           October 21, 2026                                 Page 1 of 2
Planning & Development Standing Committee
Wednesday, October 21, 2026 – 6:00 p.m.
Harbormaster Conference Room
19 Harbor Loop
Gloucester, MA 01930
-Minutes-
Planning & Development Committee Present: Chair, Councilor Jason Grow; Vice Chair, Councilor
Dylan Benson; Councilor Hannah Kimberley
This meeting was conducted in person and remotely through ZOOM
Councilor Grow called the P&D meeting to order at 6:01 p.m.
Councilor Grow announced the names of the P&D Committee members in attendance.
1. CC#2026-012 (Memhard): Amend GZO Sec. 3.2.1 “Dimensional Requirements for Single, Two-
Family and Three-Family Dwellings” by increasing the minimum lot area per dwelling unit (sf)
requirement for the RC-40 (Coastal Residential) zoning district by DELETING “20,000 sf” and
ADDING “40,000 sf.” (cont. from July 8, 2026) 
Summary of Discussion: Councilor Grow stated that Councilor Memhard had requested the matter be
withdrawn. 
MOTION: On a motion by Councilor Grow, seconded by Councilor Kimberley, the Planning &
Development Committee voted 3 in favor, 0 opposed, to withdraw the matter without prejudice.
2. Special Event Application (#EVNT-26-58): Request for street closures for the Middle Street 
Walk on December 12, 2026
Summary of Discussion: Councilor Grow stated that this event was the same as previous years.
MOTION:  On a motion by Councilor Grow, seconded by Councilor Benson, the Planning & 
Development Committee voted 3 in favor, 0 opposed, to permit the Middle Street Walk Committee 
to close Middle Street from School Street to Washington Street on December 12, 2026 from 12:00 
p.m. to 3:00 p.m., with the following conditions:
1. Road Closure Plans:  Roads to be closed are to be marked with signage directing the public
as to the duration of the closure and alternate routes.  Any substantial changes, as 
determined by either the Police or Fire Chief or their designees to the route or related to 
safety issues will require Council approval.
2. Notification of Immediate Abutters and Businesses:  Notice shall be made by the event 
organizer by hand or by mail no later than 7 days in advance of the event.
3. Police Detail to be located at the intersection of Middle Street/Washington Street and
Church Street/Washington Street.
Planning & Development                           October 21, 2026                                 Page 2 of 2
MOTION TO ADJOURN: On a motion by Councilor Benson, seconded by Councilor Kimberley,
the Planning & Development Committee voted 3 in favor, 0 opposed, to adjourn the meeting at 6:05
p.m.
Submitted by: Lynds S. Jones, Legislative Aide
Documents submitted at the meeting:  None.
Matters appearing on the agenda that are to be continued: None.
